newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES hits all-time high, 5,000 esc seen.
newsitem.headline: BES hits all-time high, 5,000 esc seen.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese bank Banco Espirito Santo (BES) surged five percent from yesterday to an all-time high of 4,870 after the release of strong six-month profit results and dealers said the share was targeting 5,000 escudos.

"Neither yesterday nor today could one have forecast the level that BES would reach, but now that 4,870 escudos has been broken, the next target is 5,000," said one operator. "This could be achieved soon if the tone is optimistic in the coming sessions."
Another operator said: "This rise is being supported solely by the bank's six-month results and by optimism for the end of the year, despite the bank president's caution about the second half."
A third operator said: "The market is purely and simply comparing results of BCP, BPI and BES and has reached the conclusion that this is the best stock."
BES shares closed at 4,870, up 250, in volume of 591,988 shares.
BES's consolidated net six-month profit rose 43 percent year-on-year to 15.2 billion escudos.
